comment: Read automatically by depcheck, which update-npm-deps.ps1 runs at the end of every sweep to report declared
dependencies nothing appears to use. depcheck cannot see a package that is only invoked as a CLI from a script,
named as a string in a config, or pulled in by a compiler option, so each name below is a verified false positive
with the reference that proves it. Because this file exists, anything depcheck still reports fails the sweep -
so a genuinely unused dependency cannot be waved through, and a new entry here needs its reason recorded.
The key is `ignores`, depcheck's CLI-style rc name; `ignoreMatches` is the API-only spelling and is silently
ignored in this file.
A theme runs through most of this list: depcheck parses .ts and .js, but not .astro and not .css, which is where
an Astro site does much of its importing.
@astrojs/check - run as a CLI: scripts/build.ts runs `astro check`, which is a no-op stub unless this package is installed.
@pagefind/default-ui - imported twice by src/pages/search.astro (`@pagefind/default-ui/css/ui.css` and a dynamic
`import("@pagefind/default-ui")`); depcheck does not parse .astro.
@tailwindcss/typography - never imported: src/styles/typography.css loads it with `@plugin "@tailwindcss/typography"`.
dayjs - imported by src/components/Datetime.astro, along with its utc and timezone plugins; depcheck does not parse .astro.
esbuild - nothing imports it; it is declared so the `"esbuild": "$esbuild"` overrides shorthand has a version to resolve against.
pagefind - run as a CLI by scripts/build.ts (`pagefind --site dist`), which builds the search index into dist/.
prettier - run as a CLI by scripts/format.ts and scripts/format-check.ts; .prettierrc.mjs only references its type.
prettier-plugin-astro - named as a string in .prettierrc.mjs's `plugins`, never imported.
prettier-plugin-tailwindcss - same: a string in .prettierrc.mjs's `plugins`.
tailwindcss - never imported: src/styles/global.css pulls it in with `@import "tailwindcss"`, resolved by the
@tailwindcss/vite plugin. depcheck does not parse .css.
yaml - nothing imports it; it is declared so the `"yaml": "$yaml"` overrides shorthand has a version to resolve against.
